messages:
alex: quick heads up — opened PR #48722 for the binary mmap allocator race fix. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/48722
alex: change touches allocator + eviction path and adds a guarded startup flag `--mmap-strict`. need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes before merge.
sam: @alex can you give a 2-line risk summary? platform can triage quickly if it’s not network-facing.
alex: 2-line: fixes mmap race during hot-reload that can corrupt pinned pages; no new external network calls; introduces a feature flag for strict mode. default behavior unchanged.
priya: tagging security. i’ll do an initial pass later today. did you add notes to the threat matrix?
alex: not yet — i added a TODO in the PR description. snippet of the flag usage:
```
# default off
runtime --mmap-strict=false
# ops can enable strict in regulated clusters
```
miguel: infra note: change touches host pinning ioctl path. i need to validate on our restricted nodes. can you add a simple canary test harness I can run?
alex: added a branch `integration/mmap-canary-test` with a small harness and CI job. CI passes unit tests. cc @jenna for canary slot.
jenna: I can schedule a canary tomorrow 07:00 PT. prefer to hold merge until canary + security thumbs-up. :eyes:
priya: initial code skim looks fine. i'll leave a couple comments about KMS key access logging and audit entries — likely small nits.
sam: platform asks for a runtime startup validation: fail fast when `--mmap-strict=true` && node is not in the `dedicated` pool (prevents accidental enabling in shared infra). can we add that?
alex: good catch. I'll add startup validation today — not a big change.
miguel: infra will wait for the canary run and the pinning validation. ping me when canary starts and i’ll run the restricted node test.
jenna: canary scheduled for 07:00 PT tomorrow. i’ll post logs to #eng-infra and link results here. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed for PR 48722 on branch integration/mmap-canary-test — awaiting manual canary run
alex: thanks — plan: i’ll push platform validation + address priya’s security comments by EOD, canary tomorrow morning, then merge window after green.
priya: if my comments are just nits we can do a tiny follow-up patch, but prefer we fix anything that affects auditing before merge.
alex: agreed. will prioritize audit logging change. tagging this thread for async updates. @sam @miguel @priya @jenna
